quests.title: Theater Mechanicus

dialogue.t: Come, try your hand at Theater Mechanicus!

dialogue.sit: How come there's Theater Mechanicus here...

dialogue.t: W—Welcome! I am a local representative for this new game from Liyue. It's called Theater Mechanicus!
In short, it is a game that can be played on a board. It was first invented by Ms. Ruijin from Liyue.
Well, according to Ms. Ruijin, I am one of their overseas agents.
After I obtained... umm... the distribution rights, Ms. Ruijin sent me a complete set of Theater Mechanicus and the business model that goes with it.
Although it initially got confiscated by the Outlander Affairs Agency... It took me a while to get this copy of the game back.

dialogue.sit: Why did the Outlander Affairs Agency confiscate this...

dialogue.t: Anyway. Let's not talk about this.
Do you see these things laid out on the table here? These are all important items used in Theater Mechanicus.
Does it feel like Liyue? Hahaha, this version was tailor-made according to the descriptions in Ms. Ruijin's letter.
I even had someone make this table... It cost me a fortune.
And per Ms. Ruijin's suggestions, I added new features to Theater Mechanicus.
Well... Anyway, it's better to learn through practice. Why don't you just give it a go? You'll understand after you play it.
Sure thing! Enjoy the brand-new version of Theater Mechanicus! You won't be disappointed!

quests.description: You discover someone who is currently promoting Theater Mechanicus in Inazuma…
